name: oxipng

evidence.result: Six 64x64 PNGs (3 RGBA, 3 8-bit palette with tRNS) totalling 32671 B became 1120 B under --strip safe (saved 31551 B, 96.57%); decoded RGBA SHA-256 equal to input for every frame; text chunks and tIME removed, pHYs kept; repeat output byte-identical; contact sheet inspected.
evidence.scope: Generated RGBA and palette PNGs at -o 4 with --strip safe: decoded pixels identical, no size growth, text/tIME stripped; oxipng 10.1.0, macOS arm64. Not other presets or depths.

summary: Rust CLI and library that recompresses PNG data and may reduce bit depth or colour type while retaining decoded image appearance; its lossless optimization makes it suitable for asset-size reduction.
use_when: When lossless PNG size reduction is useful
When preserving decoded pixels matters more than encoding time

assessment.rationale: Official project/docs describe a plausible automation route and concrete VCR job; release recency was not established from the sources read, so maintenance remains unknown.
